type Raw string
var FailureNames
type Ref struct
  Store string
  Digest string
  Size int64
  Locator string
type FindResult struct
  Reference *Ref
func Encode(v *Ref) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*Ref, error)
type Store interface
  Name() (string, error)
  Find(digest string) (FindResult, error)
  Place(digest string, size int64) (Ref, error)
type Local interface
  Path(reference Ref) (string, error)
type Writable interface
  Commit(reference Ref) error
